subject: Request: sandbox subsidy authorization for Medora VPC pilot
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medorahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Dawn Li <dawn.li@medorahealth.com>
Date: 2025-09-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sandbox subsidy request for VPC pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Medora is excited to validate Redwood in our secure staging environment. Our security team has asked for a short POC running in an isolated VPC for 4 weeks. To make the pilot viable for us (compute + data transfer), can Redwood sponsor a sandbox subsidy for the initial run?

Key asks:
- 4 weeks of isolated VPC access for up to 3 engineers (peak load ~10k tokens/day)
- Temporary uplift of quota and a $5,000 credit toward usage
- Evidence of SOC 2 controls or a redacted attestation we can share with our InfoSec leads

We can sign a standard NDA and provide a short threat-model doc. Would appreciate if you can outline the approval path and any timing constraints — we hope to start the week of Oct 6.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director of Product, Medora Health
samir.patel@medorahealth.com
(415) 555-0192

[Attachment: medora-supplement-answers.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medorahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox subsidy request for VPC pilot

Hi Samir — great to hear Medora wants to kick the tires. Short reply on process and next steps:

What we need from Medora to start approvals:
- Signed NDA (we can accept DocuSign or PDF)
- Short list of required compliance artifacts (e.g., SOC 2 redacted report, data residency constraints)
- A brief runbook describing the PII/non-PII classification and test data plan

Internal note for approvals: tagging Markus for commercial approval and Soojin for security review. My ask to the approvals committee: target a conditional credit (pilot subsidy) while security confirms artifacts.

Proposed commercial ask from Medora: $5,000 credit for a 4-week isolated VPC pilot. If security requires additional hardening, we can add a modest engineering scope estimate.

Soojin — can you advise what scope of SOC2 redaction is acceptable for sharing with a prospect, and whether we need to escrow anything beyond a checklist?

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

[Inline: quoted medora-supplement-answers.xlsx]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medorahealth.com>
Date: 2025-09-13T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox subsidy request for VPC pilot

Olga / Markus / Samir — quick security input. We can provide a redacted SOC 2 report (system and control descriptions redacted to protect customer info) plus a one-page attestation summary. For sharing with prospects the items we need to redact are:

- Customer names / network identifiers
- Internal IP ranges and account IDs
- Any third-party vendor contract specifics

I've uploaded a redacted bundle to our secure Drive with a short checklist of what we provided. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-medora-soc2-redacted

Attachments: security-evidence-checklist.pdf (checklist of items shared)

From a gating perspective, the subsidy is fine to approve conditionally if:
- Medora signs an NDA (mutual)
- Pilot scope is limited to test data or synthetically-masked records (no PHI in this phase)
- We get acceptance on our minimal access policy for the sandbox

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medorahealth.com>
Date: 2025-09-16T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox subsidy request for VPC pilot

Team / Samir — reviewed the redacted evidence and Soojin's checklist. Commercial decision: authorize a conditional $4,000 pilot credit (reduced from $5k) for a single 4-week isolated VPC sandbox, subject to the following conditions:

- NDA must be signed before access is granted
- Medora confirms no PHI will be used in the pilot (engineering attestation)
- We hold the right to pause access if compliance flags are raised

If Medora wants the full $5k credit, they should accept a one-day professional services scoping call to validate any additional engineering work (we can convert that to a credit if work is not required).

Olga — please send the NDA template and the access checklist; Soojin, please keep the Drive folder updated. Samir — if this is acceptable, we can route a DocuSign NDA this week and provision a sandbox for Oct 6 start.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP Finance & GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medorahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Sandbox subsidy authorization for Medora VPC pilot

Thanks everyone — that works for us. Dawn has attached the signed NDA (scanned PDF) and confirmed that the initial pilot will use synthetic test data only.

We accept the $4,000 conditional credit and will schedule the optional scoping call if any extra engineering work is required after your review. Target start remains Oct 6.

Attached: medora_signed_nda.pdf

Best,
Samir
